song_craft: Voice: śānta couplets, mirror-light register (still, clear, unforced). Arc: light unobjectifiable (v1) → non-duality (v2) → positive declaration with division inside (v3) → difference uncut + bare list (v4) → mirror a-fortiori (v5) → address: You alone (v6) → paradox praised (v7) → seal: hymn names its close (v8). Sthāyin śānta throughout; adbhuta/ānanda color single verses. L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: Unlike the light of sun, moon, lamp — it does not shine, pervading too completely. Hence:
of light-nature itself — ‘His illumined-and-illuminator’ is a mere transacting name.
l4.sanskrit_cite: arkendudīpādyavabhāsabhinnaṃ nābhātyativyāptatayā tataśca | prakāśarūpaṃ tadiyatprakāśyaprakāśatākhyā vyavahāra eva

verses.craft: Light unobjectifiable; transacting-name end-weight (vyavahāra — convention named as convention); iyat open kept open.
verses.rejected: (a) explaining over-pervasion → killed: packed kept packed. (b) smoothing hyphen-chain → killed: awkwardness marks the mere-name.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC) / C1 essence / rasa śānta (tranquility) with adbhuta (wonder) / L2+L3 voice
